🔁 The Data Loop

  1. SOURCE — Extension captures current_multiplier + game_result (crash point) from the Spribe gateway tab.
  2. TRANSMISSION — POST /api/ingest with {operatorCode, type, multiplier/crashPoint}.
  3. PROCESSING — Bridge normalizes, keeps rolling last-200 history, persists to disk.
  4. DISPLAY — Dashboard subscribes socket.emit("subscribe", code) → live tick / crash / stats.
Spribe-OS is an analytics overlay. It does not place bets and cannot predict certified RNG outcomes. Play responsibly.
